Krea2Photoshooting.description: Varies camera, pose, expression and aspect ratio across a whole series. The person is optional via 'person_data' and gets shortened per framing; with a Wardrobe on the Person node the outfit changes over the series. 'person_data' and 'camera_label' are for optional extension packs. 'photo' is the photo number within the series, not a source of randomness - the noise seed comes out of 'image_seed'. 'refine' goes into a refine switch (the example workflows' Render node has one; off for a draft), 'filename' into Save Image's filename_prefix. 'caption' and 'photo' at the end feed Save Dataset: the training caption (trigger and what varies, never the identity) and the photo number. 'scene' and 'lighting' at the very end: the set of this photo from a Location node on 'location_data' (shortened for the close framings) and the light of the light axis - wire them into Build Prompt's scene and lighting instead of the fixed ones. 'prompt' at the end emits the assembled prompt directly (using embedded Studio settings when no separate builder nodes are wired), and 'motion' emits an image-to-video motion prompt for the current photo.
